			<strong>Genre:</strong> Post-punk, noise, indie-rock<br/><strong>Line up:</strong> Viva Rosa, Combo Qazam, Sentinel Island Disco<br/><strong>Open:</strong> 20:00 - 01:00 hrs<br/><strong>Tickets:</strong> € 8 		</div>
		<div class="text">
			<p class="intro">A night that&nbsp;moves from&nbsp;eerie, groove-driven&nbsp;post-punk&nbsp;to&nbsp;nostalgic indie rock&nbsp;and ends with&nbsp;deep, percussive disco.</p>

<p><strong>Combo Qazam</strong><br />
Combo Qazam is a post-punk band from Utrecht that relies heavily on grooves and eerie vocal harmonies. On their well-received debut Flight Music (2020), they link this to 90s indie, math rock, prog and krautrock. Rhythmic and mechanical, yet nostalgic like a warm glow. On their second album Ghost Interior (2022), the band pursues the suffering of being human. For fans of Wire, Battles, Beak&gt;, Tortoise, Pinback, Unwound, Can and Devo.<br />
<a href="https://www.instagram.com/combo_qazam" target="_blank">Insta</a> // <a href="https://open.spotify.com/artist/7knDpm1ZleLQxKi49eCnCd?si=wk5UPafWQGyIhA5hQB2hZQ" target="_blank">Spotify</a> // <a href="https://tinyroomrecords.bandcamp.com/album/ghost-interior" target="_blank">Bandcamp</a><br />
<br />
<strong>Viva Rosa</strong><br />
Inspired by the great noise bands of the late eighties and early nineties, Viva Rosa plays indie rock with a hint of alt-country and Americana. With the passing of frontman and founder Mathieu Rosmuller, the band came to an abrupt end in 2009. Since then they&#39;ve reunited a handful of times to perform his beautiful songs. Now in a new line-up, consisting of the remaining members of Viva Rosa together with two close friends, they are working on new material.<br />
<a href="https://www.instagram.com/viva_rosa_" target="_blank">Insta</a> // <a href="https://open.spotify.com/album/3LPY4rtGCpsLs2Ti2dUSye?si=zLbNb92AQ4C-7uxYR7uLeQ" target="_blank">Spotify</a>&nbsp;<br />
<br />
<strong>Sentinel Island Disco</strong><br />
Besides being a record label and club night, Sentinel Island Disco is a DJ duo that has its roots in Amsterdam. Moreover, it is a fictional island where the inhabitants seem to have eccentric party rituals. If you want to know what that looks like, you&#39;ll have to dock at Sentinel Island. Someone like Barbara Boeing or San Soda likes to go there too. Think obscure soca, ecstatic (afro) disco and deep percussive grooves from Sentinel&#39;s dark jungles.<br />
<a href="https://www.instagram.com/sentinelislanddisco" target="_blank">Insta</a> // <a href="https://open.spotify.com/artist/7IslZuhIpt37LL25Ru4sqR" target="_blank">Spotify</a> // <a href="https://soundcloud.com/sentinelislanddisco" target="_blank">Soundcloud</a></p>
